WITH customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT 
        wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
        ca_state AS ctr_state,
        SUM(wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM web_returns
    JOIN date_dim ON wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2000
    JOIN customer_address ON wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY 
        wr_returning_customer_sk, 
        ca_state
),
customer AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id AS c_customer_id,
        c.salutation AS c_salutation,
        c.first_name AS c_first_name,
        c.last_name AS c_last_name,
        c.preferred_cust_flag AS c_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.birth_day AS c_birth_day,
        c.birth_month AS c_birth_month,
        c.birth_year AS c_birth_year,
        c.birth_country AS c_birth_country,
        c.login AS c_login,
        c.email_address AS c_email_address,
        c.last_review_date_sk AS c_last_review_date_sk
    FROM customer
),
customer_address_filtered AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.address_sk AS ca_address_sk,
        ca.state AS ca_state
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE state = 'AR'
)
SELECT 
    ctr.ctr_customer_sk AS c_customer_id,
    c.c_salutation AS c_salutation,
    c.c_first_name AS c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name AS c_last_name,
    c.c_preferred_cust_flag AS c_preferred_cust_flag,
    c.c_birth_day AS c_birth_day,
    c.c_birth_month AS c_birth_month,
    c.c_birth_year AS c_birth_year,
    c.c_birth_country AS c_birth_country,
    c.c_login AS c_login,
    c.c_email_address AS c_email_address,
    c.c_last_review_date_sk AS c_last_review_date_sk,
    ctr.ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return AS ctr
JOIN customer ON ctr.ctr_customer_sk = c.customer_sk
JOIN customer_address_filtered ON ctr.ctr_state = ca.ca_state AND ctr.ctr_customer_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
WHERE 
    ctr.ctr_total_return > (
        SELECT AVG(ctr2.ctr_total_return) * 1.2
        FROM customer_total_return AS ctr2
        WHERE ctr2.ctr_state = ctr.ctr_state
    )
AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT ctr_customer_sk FROM customer_address_filtered)
ORDER BY 
    c.c_customer_id, 
    c.c_salutation, 
    c.c_first_name, 
    c.c_last_name, 
    c.c_preferred_cust_flag, 
    c.c_birth_day, 
    c.c_birth_month, 
    c.c_birth_year, 
    c.c_birth_country, 
    c.c_login, 
    c.c_email_address, 
    c.c_last_review_date_sk, 
    ctr.ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100
